title: Bonds to Increase Safety, Security; Repair, Improve Schools; Increase Accountability
ballot_label: Caption: Bonds to Increase Safety, Security; Repair, Improve Schools; Increase Accountability (Question and summary not retrievable; see collection_notes.)
summary: Gladstone School District general obligation bond measure. The district's bond information site describes a $55.3 million bond for repairs such as roofs, boilers, fire alarm and life safety systems, and ADA updates, estimated to reduce the current bond tax rate by $1.45 per $1,000, with a $10.2 million state matching grant if passed.
yes_means: A yes vote authorizes the Gladstone School District to issue general obligation bonds for school safety, security, repairs and improvements.
no_means: A no vote does not authorize the bonds.
fiscal_impact: District bond site: $55.3 million; 'estimated to reduce the current tax rate by $1.45 per $1,000 of assessed value' (current bond levy rate $4.28 to $2.83 per $1,000); $10.2 million state OSCIM matching grant if passed. Official ballot-title estimate not retrieved.
gaps: No YES argument found in T1/T3 sources (pamphlet arguments unreadable; no 2026 press coverage found).
No NO argument found in T1/T3 sources (same searches).
collection_notes: yes_means/no_means: Oregon local ballot titles carry no official result-of-vote statement; these are neutral one-sentence descriptions written by the collector strictly from the official ballot question/summary. County voters' pamphlet (https://docs.clackamas.us/documents/drupal/03f4f9db-a1ab-4a1f-9ce1-16059d49a513) lists this measure in its index, but WebFetch text extraction ends at page C-33 (~117k chars), before the measure section, so the pamphlet's explanatory statement and any filed arguments could not be read. The county ballot-title PDF linked from the election page returned only the multilingual accommodations notice (likely an image scan). Fiscal facts from gladstoneschoolbond.org (home and FAQ pages), linked as 'Website for proposed 2026 bond' from gladstone.k12.or.us navigation; the site names no publisher or 'paid for by' line, so treat as district informational material pending reviewer confirmation. The site says the bond is on the 'November 2026 ballot' and references Measure 3-644. A prior Gladstone bond (Measure 3-624, ~$70M) failed in May 2025. savegladstoneschools.com (bond information site, ownership unknown) blocked by robots. Inventory title matches county caption.
